rules.quote: public static final int MAX_MANA = 1000000; private static final int MAX_MANA_DILLUTED = 10000;
rules.topic: Mana pool capacity in mana units: normal pool 1000000, diluted pool 10000, creative pool reports the normal cap

Mana spreader variants as (burst mana per shot, internal buffer capacity, ticks before burst loss starts, burst mana loss per tick, burst speed modifier): mana and redstone spreaders are identical in throughput; elven carries 1.5x per burst; gaia carries 4x per burst with a 6.4x buffer but loses 20 mana per tick once loss starts

Burst travel loss: a mana burst loses nothing during its variant's pre-loss ticks, then loses its variant's loss-per-tick amount every tick of flight; long spreader runs waste mana, gaia bursts waste 5x faster per tick than mana/elven bursts

value.model: loss = loss_per_tick x ticks beyond pre_loss_ticks

rules.topic: Mana tablet capacity: 500000 mana, exactly half a full mana pool
Terrestrial agglomeration plate: 1 terrasteel ingot costs 500000 mana and consumes 1 manasteel ingot + 1 mana pearl + 1 mana diamond (jar default recipe; datapacks may override)

Endoflame: while burning it adds 3 mana every 2 ticks (1.5 mana per tick); stored burn time = the fuel item's furnace burn time / 2, capped at 32000 ticks; example: coal (1600 tick burn time) becomes 800 burn ticks and yields 1200 mana total

Hydroangeas: consumes one adjacent water block and generates 40 mana over 40 ticks (1 mana per tick); it is a passive flower with a finite life: after 72000 ticks (60 minutes) it destroys itself and leaves a dead bush where one can survive
Thermalily: consumes one adjacent lava block and generates 45 mana per tick for 600 ticks, 27000 mana per lava block (constructor args of the fluid generator: burn time 600 ticks, 45 mana per tick)

Gourmaryllis: mana per food item = foodValue^2 x 70 x streak multiplier, where foodValue is the item's hunger restoration capped at 12 and the streak multiplier grows with dietary variety over the last foods eaten: 1, 1.3, 1.5, 1.6, 1.7, 1.75, up to 1.8 (repeating the same food resets the streak); a max-value varied food yields 12^2 x 70 x 1.8 = 18144 mana
Entropinnyum internal mana buffer is 6500 mana; it converts a primed TNT detonation in range into mana up to this buffer, so one burst of generation is capped at 6500 mana regardless of TNT count
